# OpenMeet

> Open-source, peer-to-peer audio calls, screen and webcam sharing and chat from a terminal. No account, no browser. Stereo Opus audio up to 256 kbps each way, WebRTC mesh of up to six people, self-hostable signaling server. macOS 15+ and Windows 11; Linux best effort. MIT licence.

Install with `npm i -g openmeet-terminal`, then run `openmeet`. Node.js 22 or later; ffmpeg only for screen or camera sharing. The first start asks for a name and a colour; rooms are names, typing one creates it.

Media never passes through the server: WebRTC carries audio and video directly between participants and the server only relays the signaling handshake, keeps rooms in memory and forgets them when the last person leaves.
